title: Placement Head
description:
Job description:

**Company:** Route Upskill Academy  
**Department:** Placement & Corporate Relations  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–2 years  
**Industry:** Education / Skill Development / Training

About Route Upskill Academy

Route Upskill Academy is a professional skill-development and career training institution based in Kozhikode, Kerala. We provide industry-oriented training programs designed to equip students with practical skills and connect them with suitable career opportunities.

Our major programs include:

* **Data Analytics / Business Analytics**
* **Accounting & Finance**
* **Logistics & Supply Chain Management**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented **Placement Head** to lead our placement operations and build strong relationships with companies and recruitment partners.

Job Responsibilities

* Develop and execute the placement strategy for Route Academy.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with companies, HR managers, recruiters, and industry partners.
* Identify and map potential employers across **Kerala and other key employment markets in South India**.
* Generate placement opportunities for students from **Data Analytics, Accounting & Finance, and Logistics & Supply Chain Management** programs.
* Conduct corporate outreach through calls, emails, LinkedIn and direct company visits.
* Coordinate with HR teams and recruitment agencies to generate interviews and job opportunities.
* Arrange campus recruitment drives, interviews, assessments and hiring events.
* Coordinate student profiles, resumes and interview preparation with the academic team.
* Maintain a database of companies, recruiters, job openings and placement activities.
* Track placement leads, interviews, selections, offers and joining status.
* Develop long-term corporate partnerships and explore **MOUs and recurring recruitment opportunities**.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with companies and recruiters.
* Coordinate with faculty and academic teams to understand student skills and job readiness.
* Prepare regular placement reports and submit performance updates to management.
* Meet placement targets and improve the overall placement conversion rate.
* Represent Route Academy during corporate meetings, recruitment events, job fairs and industry interactions.
* Be willing to **travel for company visits, corporate meetings and placement activities** whenever required.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We prefer candidates with:

* **1–2 years of experience in the education, training, skill-development or edtech sector.**
* Experience specifically in **placement, corporate relations, career services, recruitment or business development** will be highly preferred.
* Strong preference for candidates who have experience or understanding of:
* Data Analytics / Data Analyst roles
* Accounting & Finance
* Logistics & Supply Chain
* Existing contacts with **HR professionals, recruiters, companies and placement partners** will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of entry-level recruitment and industry hiring requirements.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent negotiation and relationship-building abilities.
* Good follow-up and coordination skills.
* Target-oriented and result-driven approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic reporting.
* Comfortable with email, LinkedIn and other professional communication platforms.
* **Willingness to travel** for corporate visits and placement activities is mandatory.
* Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with multiple internal teams.

Key Skills

**Placement Management | Corporate Relations | HR Coordination | Recruitment | Business Development | Employer Outreach | Student Placement | Client Relationship Management | Communication | Negotiation | Follow-up | MS Excel | Google Sheets | LinkedIn**

Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* Master's degree in HR, Management, Education, Social Sciences or a related field will be an added advantage.
* Relevant experience in the education/skill-development sector will be given preference.

What We Expect

The candidate should be someone who can **build relationships, generate opportunities and convert corporate connections into actual placement opportunities**.

This role requires regular communication with companies and HR teams, proactive follow-up, field visits and coordination with students and internal teams.

**Travel willingness is mandatory for this position.**

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
